Hero.intro: Hi, I'm Alex — 18, from Portugal, building without a university degree. Vice-President of Selfmade Association, founder of a five-figure agency before I turned 18, and today I help businesses build the digital systems and strategies that help them grow and scale online.

AboutIntro.title: Vice-President, Selfmade Association
AboutIntro.body: I'm the Vice-President of Selfmade Association, a youth organization based in Fundão that promotes entrepreneurship and international mobility through Erasmus+ programs. We connect young people from the interior of Portugal with opportunities abroad, and bring international youth to our region.
AboutIntro.lifestyleQuote: Over 12 years of football taught me more about discipline than anything else ever could. Today I channel that same energy into the gym, into learning and into every project I take on.
AboutIntro.lifestyleTagline: The moment you stop evolving is the moment someone else takes your spot.

items.body: I co-founded a digital agency at 16, creating funnels and digital strategies for businesses across Portugal. Before turning 18, I had already crossed five figures in revenue. I eventually left to pursue a bigger vision, but watching that agency keep growing without me is something I'll always be proud of.

I joined Selfmade Association and was elected Vice-President. We're a Fundão-based youth organization that uses Erasmus+ to fight for something simple: giving young people from the interior of Portugal the same international opportunities as everyone else.

I joined Aeternus Progressus as a consultant and team member, working on marketing and business strategy while helping public and private organizations across Portugal and Europe secure European funding and navigate digitalization projects. Real clients, real projects, already running.

Stats.title: Stats & Facts
Stats.intro: I started with no budget, no team and no roadmap. Just a clear belief that hard work and the right systems could make a difference. Every number below was earned, not given.
Stats.education: From 2022 to 2025 I completed a Computer Programming course at Escola Profissional do Fundão, where I served as class and course representative and graduated as a merited student with a final grade of 18 out of 20.

Story.question: How it Started?
Story.body1: I started in the business world at 16, and after trying several models, I joined forces with a friend and we founded an agency where we built digital funnels to help companies in the interior of Portugal grow online. At the time, I gave up on going to university, and even before I was 18, we had already made five figures in revenue with our own business.
Story.body2: However, despite being a co-founder, I decided to leave to take advantage of a better opportunity, but I love continuing to see the agency I founded grow even though I'm no longer involved in operations.
